name: Idiopathic guttate hypomelanosis
advice: Harmless sun-related white spots that do not spread like vitiligo. Daily sunscreen prevents new spots. Individual spots respond best to clinic procedures (light cryotherapy, needling, fractional laser); creams give modest benefit.
